explanation: The theorem is functoriality (composition law) of `mapElementarySubgroup`, a definition local to this library. It is the restriction of `mapRingHom` to the elementary subgroup. Mathlib has no `elementarySubgroup` or `mapElementarySubgroup` (grep found nothing), so no Mathlib declaration states this. The only Mathlib lemmas it resembles are generic functoriality laws, such as `GeneralLinearGroup.map_comp`, and these are about the unrestricted map. They say nothing about the subtype-restricted homomorphism, so they are not a one- or two-line derivation. The content lies in the library's own definitions.
